footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to COPT Defense: includes a $947K income tax benefit; after $7.8M attributable to noncontrolling interests. The income statement has no operating income line; it is shown here as revenue less the operating expense lines, with interest and other non-operating items below it.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 1.4% to $764M in 2025. Gross margin was 62.8%, versus 64.7% a year earlier, and operating income rose 9.6% to $234M, a 30.6% margin.
Net income rose 9.6% to $152M, or $1.34 per share. Operating cash flow was $310M and free cash flow $289M, versus $300M; COPT Defense returned $137M through dividends.
sources: COPT Defense Properties Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
